info.name: Webex Admin Address Book Device Call Settings With Device Dynamic Settings API
Device Call Settings With Device Dynamic Settings
Read the List of Supported Devices

params.name: orgId
params.description: List supported devices for an organization.

params.name: allowConfigureLayoutEnabled
params.description: List supported devices that allow the user to configure the layout.

params.name: type
params.description: List supported devices of a specific type. To excluded device types from a request or query, add `type=not:DEVICE_TYPE`. For example, `type=not:MPP`.

items.docs:
Gets the list of supported devices for an organization.

Retrieving this list requires a full or read-only administrator auth token with a scope of `spark-admin:telephony_config_read`.

params.name: orgId
params.description: Settings groups for devices in this organization.

params.name: familyOrModelDisplayName
params.description: Device family or model display name to filter the `settingsGroups`.

params.name: includeSettingsType
params.description: To show groups or tabs or both. Query param is case insensitive. Default is `ALL`.

items.docs:
This API returns the `settingsGroups` that define the structure and association of tags for device dynamic settings.

 The `settingsGroups` are used to organize the tags into logical groups, making it easier to manage and configure device dynamic settings.

params.name: orgId
params.description: List of device dynamic settings in this organization.

params.name: familyOrModelDisplayName
params.description: The family or model name for the device. If no tag is specified, all tags related to `familyOrModelDisplayName` are returned.

items.docs:
Retrieve dynamic settings for specific device tags at customer level, allowing filters by `familyOrModelDisplayName` and `tag` identifier.

This API lets you request the values of multiple `Device Settings` at once by specifying a list of `familyOrModelDisplayName` and tag combinations.

This requires a full, device, or read-only administrator auth token with a scope of `spark-admin:telephony_config_read`.

params.name: locationId
params.description: Unique identifier for the `location`.

params.name: orgId
params.description: Unique identifier for the `organization` to which this location belongs.

params.name: familyOrModelDisplayName
params.description: The family or model name for the device. If no tag is specified, all tags related to `familyOrModelDisplayName` are returned.

items.docs:
Retrieve dynamic settings for specific device tags at the specified location level, allowing filters by `familyOrModelDisplayName` and `tag` identifier.

This API lets you request the values of multiple `Device Settings` at once by specifying a list of `familyOrModelDisplayName` and tag combinations for a specific location.

This requires a full, device, or read-only administrator auth token with a scope of `spark-admin:telephony_config_read`.

params.name: deviceId
params.description: Device for which to retrieve settings.

params.name: orgId
params.description: Organization to which the `device` belongs.

items.docs:
Retrieve settings for a specified device.

This API retrieves device settings based on the specified `tags`; if the `tags` field is empty or missing, all settings for the device are returned.

This requires a full, device, or read-only administrator auth token with a scope of `spark-admin:telephony_config_read`.

params.name: deviceId
params.description: Device for which to update settings.

params.name: orgId
params.description: Organization to which the device belongs.

items.docs:
Modify dynamic settings for a specified device.

This API updates device settings based on the specified `tags`. If the `tags` field is empty, the request has no effect.

This requires a full, device, or read-only administrator auth token with a scope of `spark-admin:telephony_config_write`.

params.name: orgId
params.description: Retrieve list of device dynamic settings jobs for this organization.

params.name: start
params.description: Start at the zero-based offset in the list of jobs. Default is 0.

params.name: max
params.description: Limit the number of jobs returned to this maximum count. Default is 2000.

items.docs:
List device dynamic settings jobs.

Lists all the jobs for job type `dynamicdevicesettings` for the given organization in order of most recent one to oldest one irrespective of its status.

This API requires a full or read-only administrator auth token with a scope of `spark-admin:telephony_config_read`.

info.name: Update Device Dynamic Settings Across Organization or Location

params.name: orgId
params.description: Apply update device dynamic settings for all the devices under this organization.

items.docs:
Creates a job to update device settings at location or organization level.

The job runs asynchronously and persistently, applying the requested settings in bulk to all relevant devices, which may belong to multiple families as specified in the request. If a `locationId` is provided, only devices in that location are affected.

A unique job ID is returned to track status and errors.

Only one job can run per customer per organization at a time. Additionally, this job cannot run in parallel with

info.name: Get Device Dynamic Settings Job Status

params.name: jobId
params.description: Retrieve job details for this `jobId`.

items.docs:
Get device dynamic settings job status.

Provides details of the job with `jobId` of `jobType` `dynamicdevicesettings`.

This API requires a full or read-only administrator auth token with a scope of `spark-admin:telephony_config_read`.

info.name: List Device Dynamic Settings Job Errors

params.name: jobId
params.description: Retrieve job details for this `jobId`.

params.name: orgId
params.description: Retrieve the status of job for this organization.

params.name: start
params.description: Specifies the offset from the first result that you want to fetch. Default is 0.

params.name: max
params.description: Specifies the maximum number of records that you want to fetch. Default is 2000

items.docs:
List Update device dynamic settings job errors.

Lists all error details of the job with `jobId` of `jobType` `dynamicdevicesettings`.

This API requires a full or read-only administrator auth token with a scope of `spark-admin:telephony_config_read`.
